data.summary: The scd2_batch directory contains SQL scripts implementing Slowly Changing Dimension Type 2 (SCD2) batch loading strategies, utilizing staging and merge patterns to track historical data changes.

file_insights.name: single_merge.sql
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a single atomic MERGE statement into the target dimension table using a unioned staging dataset.
file_insights.detailed_description: Performs a single atomic MERGE operation to handle SCD Type 2 dimension updates by creating a dual-stream union where one stream closes the active version and another inserts the new version.
responsibilities: Close current version of updated records
Insert new version of updated records atomically

file_insights.name: stage.sql
file_insights.source_summary: Defines staging selection criteria to capture new, interrupted, or modified records for SCD Type 2 processing.
file_insights.detailed_description: Filters and stages rows that require new versions based on brand-new keys, interrupted current versions, or updated tracked attributes.

file_insights.name: two_step.sql
file_insights.source_summary: Executes a two-step pattern closing active records with a MERGE and opening new versions with an INSERT statement.
file_insights.detailed_description: Executes a two-step process to perform SCD Type 2 updates, first closing current versions and then opening new versions via an insert statement.
responsibilities: Close current dimension versions in step 1
Insert new dimension versions in step 2
